A light at Reedbank

A lantern wick, a warm home, and a road beside the water. Begin in your riverbank dwelling, meet the festival folk on the landing, and follow the eastern bank path into Woodland Road. The elven wayfarers have a camp beyond the bend. The old Greenwood adventure and the wider world continue from there.

WASD/arrows walk · E interacts · Space dashes · J opens the way-pack · F toggles fullscreen. Escape closes the current dialogue or way-pack first. Touch controls appear over the scene, including fullscreen. Controller: stick or D-pad walks, A interacts, B closes, X dashes, Y opens the pack. Recall difficulty and dialogue length are separate settings. F2 shows authored collision, walking surfaces, doors and roof groups.

Read and keep way-cards before using them. Choose four favorites for practice; encounters draw four discoveries independently. Settings preserves phrase selection, multiple choice, typing, full excerpts, optional music and your private Markdown imports. Export progress for portable backups.

Scripture is God's Word; Christ is Lord and Creator. Recall unlocks fictional actions and opportunities. Game success does not measure faith, and a missed word carries no moral judgment.
